Bike rental is only one part of what we do. Whether you rent a bike or bring your own, EasyTravelBike helps coordinate the local support your Taiwan cycling trip needs.

單車租賃

提供車友及團體所需的單車或電輔車租賃。

單車運輸

協助租賃車或自備車在機場、飯店及騎乘的起點跟終點做運送。

支援車跟隨或駐點服務

可安排適當車輛協助單車、行李或補給品的運送及隨行。

保姆車跟隨或駐點服務

可安排適當車輛協助單車、行李、人員或補給品的接駁運送及隨行。

行李轉運

可協助自由行或團體車友的行李，在住宿地點轉運（車友本身可輕裝騎行無負擔）。

旅客接駁支援

依旅客人數、行李、單車及行程需求，透過符合台灣相關法規及資格要求的交通服務業者與適當車輛進行安排。

單車領騎

由熟悉騎乘路線的在地領騎人員帶領車隊依規劃路線前進。此為單車騎乘支援服務，並非導遊服務。

專業技師

提供單車調整、故障處理及騎乘期間的維修支援。

請確認資料
FAQ

Questions Before You Ride.

Do I need to rent a bike?

No. Overseas riders can bring their own bikes and request local support such as bike transport, luggage transfer, passenger transfer support, support vehicles and mechanical assistance.

Can you support small VIP groups?

Yes. The service model is designed to be flexible for small groups and customized cycling programs.

Can overseas cycling clubs work with you directly?

Yes. The B2B pathway is designed for cycling clubs, bike shops, travel agencies and tour operators.

Can the itinerary be customized?

Yes. Route, dates, rider count and service combinations can be discussed as part of the inquiry.

Do you recommend travel agencies?

Yes, when appropriate. If you need travel-agency services beyond cycling support, we may introduce or provide contact information for a licensed travel agency partner. Travel services are discussed, contracted and paid for directly with that travel agency. EasyTravelBike does not sell the travel-agency package on its behalf. If you would like to double-check a travel agency, you can review the Taiwan Tourism Administration's public travel-agency records: https://www.tad.gov.tw/m1.aspx?sNo=0000148

When would EasyTravelBike recommend a travel agency to assist?

If your trip requires accommodation, flights, a packaged Taiwan tour, itinerary arrangements or other travel-agency services, we may provide information or a referral to a suitable licensed travel agency partner when appropriate. EasyTravelBike remains responsible for cycling-side services such as cycling equipment, bike transport, luggage support and cycling logistics. The travel agency is responsible for its own travel-agency services, and you contact, contract and pay the travel agency directly. When making a referral, we aim to clearly identify the travel agency and check current public registration information. Partner status can change, so you should also confirm the agency directly.
